module: Editing constants of the rally driveline (editable spline built from the recce recording). Used by drivelineV3: default node width, RDP simplification tolerance, minimum number of subdivisions and minimum spline spacing.

defaultSplineWidth.desc: Default width of a spline node: 10.0 m.

defaultSimplificationTolerance.desc: RDP algorithm tolerance when simplifying the recorded points: 1.0 (m).

minSplineSpacing.desc: Minimum spacing between subdivided points: 2.0 m.
